lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr₂Ag₆Sn₂ (reduced formula ZrAg₃Sn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 10 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Sn centers each surrounded by 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Zr centers have 16 neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner- and edge-sharing between Ag-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and between Sn- and Zr-centered polyhedra.
